items.title: 67251_Chuck Green oral history interview
items.q: So, he happened to play this melody, "Let the Good Times Roll", and it eventually became the theme song to the Symphony Sid's disk jockey program on the radio. So, I acquired another friend.

ctx.x: And the musicians, I would take it, to start picking up on the tap dancers and what they could do?

Yes. They even started to imitate them. The improvisations that the tap dancers did, in their tap dancing. --like say, for instance, They began to realize that it was jazz (Unintelligible) Lester Young -- the late, great Lester Young. He composed a piece called "Let the Good Times Roll" and I was warming up one day on the stage, you know, just tap dancing. Because We had been riding and sitting down, you know, riding -- your muscles has a tendency to retract, you see. So, I was -- called myself getting limber,…
Did you dance to the music when he played it?
